title: Reading Drill — Evaluating hand dryers — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Evaluating hand dryers — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Foxhaven began with reports of people leaving bathrooms with damp hands. The facilities manager had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using discreet door counts and chose the number of completed drying cycles as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was adjusted sensor placement. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted seven weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded a noisy fan nearby as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
